title: Shiny Controls Theme
description: Canonical definition of a Shiny Controls theme. A theme is described by a small set of seed colors; the generator (tools/ShinyThemeGen) derives the full Material-3 tonal role set (light + dark) plus shape, elevation, state, type and spacing tokens. This same file format drives the docs-site theme creator.

name.description: Display name, e.g. 'Ocean'. Used for the generated theme class name (OceanTheme).

slug.description: Lowercase identifier used in file names and CSS, e.g. 'ocean' -> shiny-theme-ocean.css.

seeds.description: Source colors. Each is expanded into a tonal palette; M3 roles are mapped from the tones for both light and dark schemes.

shape.description: Optional override of the default corner-radius scale (px). Omit to use generator defaults.
